title: docs(pm-skill): correct three refuted readings in platform-readings; the family's additions do not fit the ratchet
body:
Part of #14133
This is the `platform-readings.md` family flight, and it lands **the corrections
only**. The eight members' additions do not fit the ratchet, and no member closes
here. Every card in the family stays open; none is addressed by a closing
keyword anywhere in this body.

## Family

Every one of these remains open after this PR, and this body carries no closing
keyword beside any of them:

- #14133 (chain head) remains open · #14694 remains open · #14743 remains open
- #14778 remains open · #14798 remains open · #14605 remains open
- #14898 remains open · #14445 remains open (its item 2 also sits on #14978)

## Headline reading

`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, at `856cfefc`:

```
check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md is 324 lines (ceiling 324; headroom 0).
```

Same before and after. Four commits, `11 insertions(+), 11 deletions(-)`, one
file.

## The measurement that decides the flight

The dispatch's mechanism assumption was that the members' own findings expose
enough redundancy in the file to pay for their additions. **Measured, they do
not, by an order of magnitude.**

- **What the additions cost: +34 lines.** Every member's fact was written out in
  the file's own voice and wrapped to the gate's real budget (120 **bytes** per
  line, which for Chinese prose is about 40 characters, not the ~96 display
  columns the file's widest lines suggest). Nothing was shortened to fit.
- **What the deletions pay: 0 lines.** The three deletions this PR makes free
  about 307 bytes of content — roughly 2.6 lines' worth — but they are spread
  across three different bullets and none of them completes a whole line inside
  its own bullet. Reclaiming them would mean re-wrapping paragraphs the edit does
  not touch, which is exactly the 2026-08-17 筹行 ruling's ban.
- **The largest named payment candidate is not one.** The dispatch offered the
  `:302-306` count tombstone "if its lesson is elsewhere". It is not elsewhere,
  and more to the point that block was moved into this file **byte-identically**
  about an hour before this flight, as the destination of the authorised
  cross-file move that set the current 324 ceiling. Deleting it would silently
  undo that landing and leave the declared move describing content that no longer
  exists. It is off the table, and the ratchet's own comment block is the
  evidence.

Per-member cost of what is still owed, each measured by writing it and wrapping
it, not estimated:

| member | what is still owed | lines |
|---|---|--:|
| chain head | the 422 ceiling at offset ~9,900 and the `asc` + `desc` partition recipe | +5 |
| payload channel | the claim-bearing-field rule and the absence-claim rule | +5 |
| search query form | no GitHub qualifiers in `query`; scope by parameter; sentence queries | +3 |
| channel envelopes | try-the-other-channel on any refusal (+5) and the label-removal carve-out (+1) | +6 |
| merge-queue instruments | queue-ref position chain (+3), merge-driver caveat (+3), full-page zero (+2) | +8 |
| queue progress | the `event=merge_group` instrument and the batch-naming trap | +2 |
| shift-end report | `check_suite.completed` is a wake (+1); the tier script answers only its own tree (+2) | +3 |
| body repair | the raw-body source for the lossy case | +2 |
| | **total** | **+34** |

## What landed, and why each is free

Each of the four is a deletion or a date. All four are things triage named as the
lead for their card, and all four are cheap precisely because they remove text
rather than add it.

| # | commit | member | ratchet |
|--:|---|---|--:|
| 1 | drop the overturned `enable_pr_auto_merge` echo reading | merge-queue instruments — triage: "lead with this, not with the four duplicates" | 0 |
| 2 | the payload channel is precise on body only | payload channel — triage scope item 1: "a sentence that says 精确 has to stop saying it" | 0 |
| 3 | retire the refuted 「qualifiers only narrow」 tombstone | search query form — the tombstone that points away from the defect that card measured | 0 |
| 4 | date the two further confirmations on the `auto_merge` bullet | queue progress — triage: "a date on the existing bullet, not a new line" | 0 |

The first three remove statements the file makes that later controlled
measurements refute. That is worth landing on its own: a reference that
contradicts itself sends the reader whichever way they happen to grep, and one of
these three demonstrably sent a seat toward filing a platform defect that did not
exist.

## Dedup performed, and what it found already recorded

Read against `origin/main` before writing anything. Facts a member asked for that
the file **already carries**, and which are therefore cited rather than
re-spelled:

- `mergeable_state: unknown` during queue membership is normal recomputation —
  already in the 惰性计算 bullet.
- `auto_merge` is not a decision basis — already stated more strongly than the
  card states it; this PR adds only the two dates.
- `merge-base --is-ancestor` is the wrong landing instrument — already in the
  「不在 origin/main 上」 bullet.
- The `SQUASH` in / `merge` out echo mismatch, and its inertness on a queue repo
  — already in the 回显两向不可靠 bullet.
- A backticked HTML-comment marker being stripped, and the escaped spelling
  surviving — already in the write-side sanitizer bullets.
- The os-dev seat's repo-scoped REST 403 plus payload-channel reads while MCP
  writes work — already in the 按班矩阵 and the degrade ladder.
- Two-label `list_issues` returning the union — already recorded from three
  seats; a fourth reading is a date at most.

## Scope, and what was deliberately not done

- File surface held: `platform-readings.md` only.
- The ceiling map was not touched, no cross-file move was declared, and
  `rest-channel.md` was not edited.
- The table was not restructured. Two payment candidates that would have been
  "while I'm here" edits with no member behind them were measured and left alone:
  a duplicate `get`-at-the-decision-point clause, and the container-has-no-`gh`
  boundary that another bullet also carries. Both are reported as payment
  candidates for the next increment rather than spent here.
- Nothing was shortened to fit. Where a member's fact would only fit by dropping
  its failure mode or its boundary, it was left out whole.
